name: University of Warwick
description: The University of Warwick is a public research university founded in 1965, with its main campus on the southern edge of Coventry in the English Midlands. It is a member of the Russell Group and is known for economics, mathematics, business and computer science.
whyIncluded: The University of Warwick is among the 10 universities in the United Kingdom most chosen by international students (9,475 non-UK students in 2024-25, HESA), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026; its LLB is on the Singapore Institute of Legal Education's list of overseas scheduled universities and its MBChB on the Singapore Medical Council's list.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBChB, graduate entry)
programmes.summary: Year 1 of this 4-year graduate-entry medical degree costs £32,510 at 2026-27 rates; years 2 to 4 cost £56,660 a year, and fees may rise each year with inflation. No separate compulsory fees.
programmes.notes: Warwick Student Finance 'UG Overseas Fees' table (fetched 2026-10-07), rows 'Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery (Year 1)' A101 and '(Years 2-4)': 2025-26 £30,670 / £53,460; 2026-27 £32,510 / £56,660; 2027-28 TBA, so the latest published year (2026) is used. Warwick's MBChB is a four-year graduate-entry degree, so it is listed under Master's per the README rule; first-year fee recorded, later-year rate here. Warwick Medical School was added to the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable qualifications from 1 January 2025 (news reports of the SMC update). Continuing-student fees may rise with an inflationary uplift. laterYears added 2026-10-08 from the figures above; annualTuition is now the year-1 figure.
